fossil
The papersThe code

Adverse drug reaction prediction, dug back up.

The authors' pipeline was never released. We rebuilt it from the paper and reran it on their own training file: 832 drugs, 1,385 ADRs and their folds. Of 36 results, 3 came back exact, 19 agree, 9 partly, 2 differ and 3 were not attempted.

Install adrfusion

Python package
pip install "git+https://github.com/jeonglab-bcm/fossil#subdirectory=PMC3392844/package"

Python 3.10 or later; NumPy, SciPy and scikit-learn.

The main claim holds: in our run adding biological and phenotypic features to chemical structures raises AUC from 0.9054 to 0.9525, precision from 43.32% to 65.31% and recall from 49.48% to 63.84% (paper 0.9054 to 0.9524, 43.37% to 66.17%, 49.25% to 63.06%).   • KS tests on per-ADR AUCs (Bonferroni-corrected): chem to chem+bio p = 1.45E-07 and chem to chem+bio+pheno p = 1.10E-15, both significant; the drop from pheno to chem+bio+pheno is not (p = 0.177): 3 of 6 fields as printed.
  • Method comparison: SVM performs best, followed by RF, KNN, NB and LR; SVM's precision (66.17%) and recall (63.06%) beat RF's (63.10%, 62.50%): 3 of 4 fields as printed.
  • Discussion: class weights (1 - class share) raise RF's AUC from 0.9491 to 0.9524; SVM does not improve: 1 of 3 fields as printed.
  • Clinical validation: chem detects 1 of 7 rhabdomyolysis ADRs and 0 of 4 heart-attack ADRs, chem+bio 5 and 0, chem+bio+pheno 5 and 2; every classifier detects both grouped ADRs: 4 of 7 fields as printed.

The main claim holds: in our run adding biological and phenotypic features to chemical structures raises AUC from 0.9054 to 0.9525, precision from 43.32% to 65.31% and recall from 49.48% to 63.84% (paper 0.9054 to 0.9524, 43.37% to 66.17%, 49.25% to 63.06%). The claims that do not match come from the unstated variant of the KS test, the LR and NB settings, the class weighting of RF (our AUC falls), the unstated threshold of Table 4 and the precision and recall points behind Fig. 5.

What we matched

What the reproduction stands on.

Data
The authors' training file, from Zhang et al. 2015's supplement (CC BY 4.0): 832 drugs, every feature bit and the fold of each drug for each ADR.
Method
adrfusion, rebuilt from the paper's Methods: one classifier per ADR, LIBSVM's RBF kernel with g 0.008 and C 2, micro-averaged ROC.
Figures
The published ROC curves read from the PDF's vector paths, our curves drawn on the published frames at 600 dpi.
